[This Note is in effect from August 6, 1966, vide notification no. G-II—2362/X—3-56, dated July 18, 1966.]

Prior to amendment the aforesaid Note stood as follows :

Note—If the military pension of a person does not exceed Rs. 15 a month, it shall not be taken into account in fixing his pay and allowances in the Civil Department.
